problem: Says signal handling covers SIGTERM, SIGPIPE and SIGHUP. That's right except on Windows: setup_signal_handlers registers SIGHUP and SIGPIPE only when the signal module defines them (POSIX), so Windows gets only SIGTERM. The SIGPIPE disconnect pattern later on the page can never appear there.
replacement: 2. **Signal handling** - SIGTERM on every platform, plus SIGPIPE and SIGHUP on POSIX systems (Windows doesn't define them), to detect disconnects
route_reason: Platform-conditional signal registration has no extractor and can't be shown by an MCP example (it runs at process start, not through a tool).
